WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_count
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m
    ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
  WHERE m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  WHERE insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY insurstat
)
SELECT
  sr.insurstat,
  AVG(sr.avg_ratio) AS above_avg_sites_avg_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS above_avg_site_count,
  AVG(sr.avg_ratio - sa.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio
FROM site_ratios AS sr
JOIN status_averages AS sa
  ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat
WHERE sr.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
GROUP BY sr.insurstat;
